title: Paused: ResNet18d 300 ep at 288 px (R_r18d_i288) and corrupt_v5 variant (R_r18d_v5)
summary: Paused for shared-GPU etiquette; checkpoints saved
hypothesis: (a) 288 px training at 300 epochs, and (b) adding blur, downscale and grayscale (corrupt_v5) should match the test blur better.
findings: Smoke test of the patched train.py passed (2 epochs, F1 computed, done.json written).
limitations: Resume from ckpt.pt requires restarting the same command.
